name: Sparc Al Inc
summary: Sparc AI Inc. is a software and engineering firm specializing in the creation, patenting, and commercialization of its proprietary SPARC (Spatial, Predictive, Approximation, and Radial Convolution) technology. This innovative SPARC solution empowers various devices—such as sensors, cameras, and smartphones, regardless of whether they are fixed, mobile, airborne, portable, or handheld—to function as precise target coordinate acquisition systems. The company's portfolio also includes a Target Acquisition System, a software platform engineered to determine the exact location of any distant object, alongside an autonomous flight module currently under development. Established in 2018, Sparc AI Inc. was formerly known as EYEFI Group Technologies Inc. before rebranding in August 2023, and its operations are based in Melbourne, Australia.
